mainEntity.name: Is this an AI receptionist for truck repair shops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Kaico Voice is an AI receptionist built for heavy-duty and fleet repair shops. It answers 24/7 with your shop name, takes the unit, the location, the PO and the contact, transfers a loaded unit down to your on-call cell, books everything else into your Google Calendar and sends you a text or email summary after each call. It tells callers it is an AI, and you can hear it yourself at (918) 359-2644.

mainEntity.name: Can it take a fleet account's PO number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fleet intake is part of the script: company, unit number, PO or authorization number, contact and callback. It lands in the transcript and on the job in the job system, so the repair order starts with the paperwork already done.

mainEntity.name: Does it know a hydraulic problem from a brake problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and it does not pretend to. It captures what the caller says, in their words, and routes by the rules you set: a loaded unit down transfers to on-call, a PM request books, and anything unclear becomes a message for your team to return. Your tech reads the transcript and decides.
